summary: Describes version 2 of the Internet Key Exchange protocol, a component of IPsec used to authenticate both sides and to set up and maintain security associations. It replaced RFC 4306 and folded in the clarifications from RFC 4718. It was itself replaced by RFC 7296.

eli5.summary: Before two computers can talk secretly with IPsec, they have to prove who they are and agree on secret keys. IKEv2 is the handshake that does this. A newer document has replaced this one.

questions: how does ipsec key exchange work
